purpose: Define creation of a new IdentityCore identity and its initial IAM relationship without conflating registration with trust, merit, recommendation or authorization.

topics.name: Identity Registration
topics.purpose: Define creation of a new IdentityCore identity and its initial IAM relationship without conflating registration with trust, merit, recommendation or authorization.

semantics.identity_rule: Registration creates a new explicit stable identity.
semantics.type_rule: Identity kind such as person or organization is explicit.
semantics.approval_rule: Required identity approvals are explicit state/evidence.
semantics.credential_rule: Registration may create initial authentication credentials according to IAM policy, but credentials are not the semantic identity.
semantics.merit_rule: New identity starts with an independent MeritCore history and cannot inherit/merge merits from another identity by default.
semantics.authorization_rule: Registration does not grant unrelated AccessCore rights.
semantics.timestamp_rule: Registration date is explicit and may anchor downstream temporal semantics such as MeritCore weekly cadence.

invariants.rule: Identity lifecycle, authentication assurance, credential state and session state remain explicit and cannot be inferred from authorization, transport or profile data.

hard_gates.condition: registration inherits prior identity merits automatically
credential value used as semantic identity
registration date unavailable where required downstream

prose.summary: Define creation of a new IdentityCore identity and its initial IAM relationship without conflating registration with trust, merit, recommendation or authorization.
